title: Real CI workflows download Renode from GitHub releases without hash check
description: Review finding (woo7 round): .github/workflows/renode.yml:26,112 and renode-firmware.yml:94,132 download renode-1.16.1.linux-portable.tar.gz from github.com/renode/renode/releases with NO hash verification, while docs/renode-workflow.md:456-457 now pins builds.renode.io artifact + sha256 (1a532d4b...). Same version, two sources: the GitHub-release artifact bytes may differ from the builds.renode.io tarball, so the docs hash cannot be assumed to cover the CI download. Pin/verify a hash for the GitHub-release artifact in the real workflows (compute it from the actual release asset). GitHub releases are also more durable than the builds server (retraction risk differs). Discovered from woo7.
